questions_on_booking.question: What's your biggest challenge with leads right now?
How many leads are in your CRM?

calendly_setup.confirmation_page_redirect: https://realsideai.com/booked (custom thank you page with video)

pre_meeting_nurture_sequence.purpose: Reduce no-show rate from ~30% to ~10% by building excitement and credibility between booking and meeting

sequence.subject: You're booked! Here's what to expect on our call
sequence.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Excited to chat on {{meeting_date}} at {{meeting_time}}!

Here's what we'll cover in our 15 minutes:

1. I'll ask a few questions about {{company_name}}'s current lead flow
2. I'll show you exactly how our AI agent works (live demo, not slides)
3. We'll crunch the numbers on how many meetings it could pull from your existing database

No pressure, no contracts — just seeing if it makes sense.

To make the most of our time, it'd be helpful if you could have a rough idea of:
→ How many total leads/contacts are in your CRM
→ When the last time those old leads were contacted

That's it. Talk soon!

Dylan
Realside AI

P.S. Here's a 2-min video showing what our AI did for a {{industry}} company last month: [LINK]

no_show_reduction_tactics: Send calendar invite from a personal email (not noreply@)
Include a personalized video in the confirmation email
Ask qualifying questions on booking form (increases investment)
Send SMS reminder 1 hour before (reduces no-shows by 50%)
Keep meeting to 15 min — lower commitment = fewer cancellations
Use language like 'quick chat' and 'no pressure' to reduce anxiety
Redirect to a thank-you page with a testimonial video after booking
If they booked from cold email, reply to the original thread confirming
